exposure: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure during 1st and 2nd trimesters
Heat wave exposure during 1st and 2nd trimesters
cohort: The study included all births recorded in the National Statistical Office of Korea from 2010 to 2016.
finding: The combined effect of heat wave and PM2.5 exposure during the 2nd trimester on the risk of preterm birth was greater than that of each exposure alone, with PM2.5 exposure increasing the impact of heat waves.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as birth between 22 and 36 weeks.
